newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe industrial stocks continue bullish.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe industrial stocks continue bullish.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrial shares continued on a bullish track on Wednesday, chalking 22.83 points to another record high.

Brokers expect the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange (ZSE) to remain generally upbeat into the new year, with many local investors trading on forecasts of good rains watering the southern African state's agriculture-based economy.
"A lot of people are taking this medium-term view. It may change if the anticipated rains don't come in the new (November-April) season," one broker said.

On Wednesday, the ZSE's key industrial index closed at 7,794.98, with advances -- including Zimbabwe Newspapers which traded 125 cents higher at 2,000 -- beating declines 11 to six on the industrial portfolio.
Selling pressure saw gold giants Ashanti and coal producer Wankie falling 100 and five cents respectively to 14,000 and 350.
The secondary seven-share mining index dropped 27.84 points to end the day at 1,230.64.
